propertiesSection.copy: Don't just choose a building; choose your daily experience. From the tech hubs of Kanata to the heritage charm of the Rideau, there is a Lépine standard tailored to you.

properties.header: Kanata Lakes: The Tech & Transit Hub
properties.lifestyleHook: Zero-commute luxury for the Silicon Valley North workforce.
localBestOf: Walkable to: The South March Highlands Innovation District.
Weekend Perk: Premier shopping at Tanger Outlets.
The Lifestyle: Urban energy meets world-class trail networks.
properties.copy: Carré Saint Louis offers the urban amenities you love without the density of downtown. Minutes from Canada's largest tech park.

properties.lifestyleHook: Bungalow-sized luxury with the Ottawa Valley as your backyard.
localBestOf: Local Treasure: Scenic walks at the swinging bridge.
Hidden Gem: Fresh local produce at the Renfrew Farmers' Market.
The Lifestyle: Quiet, community-focused living with zero maintenance.
properties.copy: Lépine Lodge offers the serenity of the Ottawa Valley. Enjoy bungalow-sized layouts with high-end finishes.

properties.lifestyleHook: Steps from the Mississippi River and downtown heritage charm.
localBestOf: Coffee Stop: Boutique cafes on Bridge Street.
Evening Plan: Sunset paddles on the Mississippi River.
The Lifestyle: Boutique living in Ontario’s fastest-growing town.
properties.copy: Johannes Gardens offers a serene riverfront lifestyle just steps from Carleton Place’s vibrant heritage downtown.

properties.header: Smiths Falls: Gateway to the Rideau
properties.lifestyleHook: Luxury at the heart of a UNESCO World Heritage site.
localBestOf: Must-See: The historic Rideau Canal locks system.
Local Brew: Artisan pints at 4 Degrees Brewing Company.
The Lifestyle: All-inclusive resort living in a historic canal town.
properties.copy: The Cristina features bungalow-sized suites and resort-style amenities at the heart of Smiths Falls.
